# Assumptions

> A portable agent skill that turns a Git diff into an evidence-backed
> Assumption Ledger: the conditions a change silently depends on, the
> repository evidence for each, what breaks if it's wrong, and a
> falsification test to settle the question.

Assumptions is a single self-contained Markdown file (`SKILL.md`) — no
build step, no dependencies, no account, no hosted backend. It works with
any coding agent that can read a skill/instruction file and inspect a
local repository. Claude Code is the reference integration.

## Invoke it

Say or send this to an agent that has the skill installed:

    Use Assumptions to review the current diff.

If the host registers slash commands, `/assumptions-scan` invokes the
same procedure. See [Usage](README.md#usage) for all modes
(`--deploy`, `--concurrency`, `--failure`, `--tests`, `--compact`).

## Install

    mkdir -p .claude/skills/assumptions
    cp SKILL.md .claude/skills/assumptions/SKILL.md

For non-Claude-Code hosts, point the agent's skill/instruction config at
`SKILL.md` directly, or paste its contents into a system prompt. Full
instructions: [Installation](README.md#installation).

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the entire skill definition — output contract,
  investigation procedure, and phrasing rules. This is the file to read
  or copy; everything else in the repo supports or documents it.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): host-neutral repo convention for when to
  auto-invoke the skill before a commit.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the same convention, Claude Code-specific.
- [README.md](README.md): full documentation — how it works, use cases,
  benchmarks, and limits.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to add examples, fixtures, or
  eval cases.

## Example output

- [examples/](examples/): full sample ledgers (duplicate payment,
  unsafe migration, cross-tenant access, webhook ordering, cache
  staleness, compact mode, falsification-tests mode).
- [fixtures/](fixtures/): small repos with known, documented hidden
  assumptions, used to benchmark the skill.
- [evals/](evals/): benchmark methodology, baseline history, and grading
  rubric — see [evals/BASELINE.md](evals/BASELINE.md) for recall/
  precision results across versions.

## Scope

Assumptions is not a generic AI code reviewer, not a static analyzer,
and not an autonomous code modifier. It only reports an assumption when
it can cite direct repository evidence with a file/line locator;
otherwise the status is `Unknown`, not a guess. See
[Limits](README.md#limits) for what it cannot verify (undocumented
production behavior, provider guarantees, deployment infrastructure).
